summary: Add retained typed Rust collection follows on one shared reconnecting socket

replay.detail: No persisted graph state or replay changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule changes or coordinated member upgrades.

compatibility.detail: Adds fractal-client follow::FollowClient, Descriptor, AttentionDescriptor and retained Stream receivers over the existing collection socket. Existing APIs and wire selectors are unchanged. Receiver clones share one subscription; slow readers coalesce intermediate states. Cancellation during watch admission and last-receiver drop release subscriptions. No notice schema, descriptor, action or server capability is introduced.

downtime.detail: No service restart or interruption is required.

manual.detail: Existing callers need no changes. Consumers opting into follows should clone one FollowClient per shared connection and inspect freshness, errors and has_more separately from retained values.

recovery.detail: No stored-state rollback or recovery changes. Reconnect and resync retain the previous window as stale until an authoritative snapshot; old subscription generations cannot replace current state.
